recommendation: REMASURE the current identity-namespace leftover-join after remeasuring it against the G31 v5 occupancy. Supersede only the leftover-join lineage, preserve the DR-104 SATISFIED token recorded at D-236, leave file 08 unchanged, and state explicitly that the bookkeeping successor does not reopen D-236.
rationale: identity-namespace-leftover-join.v6 is not merely carrying an old cross-lineage currentness sentence: basedOn.g31SpecV2 identifies the v2 harness as the specification consumed by the join, while D-208 records v5 as the current G31 occupancy and makes v2 historical. D-236 expressly separates leftover-join.v6 from the SATISFIED decision, so superseding that inert bookkeeping artifact need not reopen or replace the file-08 decision. Removing the sole remaining occupancy-specification mismatch has a concrete record-integrity benefit and avoids creating an unexplained exception to the occupancy-supersession trigger that the A4 proposal itself retains. The lack of an earlier SATISFIED-row example calls for explicit scope language, not for preserving a known stale specification dependency.

refutations.claim: DR-104's live token is SATISFIED and D-236, not leftover-join.v6, is the SATISFIED recording.
refutations.evidence: The DR-104 row in docs/v2/architecture/08-decision-and-readiness-register.md says SATISFIED 2026-08-23 (D-236 / D-056 Class B). COORD D-236 says 'leftover-join.v6 binds NOTHING and is not this SATISFIED' and leaves negative-test execution at DR-G31.

refutations.claim: identity-namespace-leftover-join.v6 has a real occupancy-specification mismatch, and it is the only current join in that class after D-292.
refutations.evidence: docs/coop/artifacts/identity-namespace-leftover-join.v6.json basedOn.g31SpecV2.path points to harness.DR-G31.identity-namespace-negative-test.preview.v2.json and its role says the join consumes that harness specification. COORD D-208 records v5 as the current G31 occupancy and says v2 is historical. Rechecking the adopted current leftover-join lineages leaves this as the only old occupancy referenced as the consumed specification; other old harness references found in anti-lockstep and sarif say 'Cited only', and g21-leftover-join.v13 separately pins occupancyV4 as current.

refutations.claim: Every leftover remasurement recorded from D-261 through D-292 targeted an OPEN row.
refutations.evidence: False counterexamples are recorded in the cited range. COORD D-273 says DR-118 stays DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED, and COORD D-275 says DR-107 stays PROPOSED-CLOSED-FOR-REVIEW; the corresponding file-08 rows carry those same non-OPEN tokens.

refutations.claim: No remasurement in the cited D-261 through D-292 range targets a SATISFIED row.
refutations.evidence: The range contains OPEN gate/row targets and the non-OPEN but unsatisfied DR-118 and DR-107 counterexamples above; none of D-261 through D-292 records a leftover successor on a SATISFIED register row.

refutations.claim: A successor would have no benefit because leftover-join.v6 no longer supplies DR-104's SATISFIED evidence.
refutations.evidence: D-236 proves only that v6 is not the SATISFIED evidence. It does not make v6's consumed-specification statement accurate. D-208 and basedOn.g31SpecV2 remain contradictory at live HEAD, and DECISIONS-NEEDED A3 plus STATUS section 3A identify this as the sole remaining occupancy-stale join. Correcting unique stale custody is a benefit even with no file-08 edit.

refutations.claim: The bytes establish a material risk that the remasurement will become CONTESTED merely because DR-104 is SATISFIED.
refutations.evidence: No cited byte supplies a probability or an objection to this act. D-236 gives the needed separation: v6 binds nothing and is not the SATISFIED recording. The cited no-cell-edit remasurements establish a review shape, while the SATISFIED token can be preserved explicitly.

refutations.claim: The work costs about forty minutes of two-reviewer time and one COORD entry.
refutations.evidence: STATUS section 3A gives a generic estimate of approximately 30-45 minutes per passing act and describes the two-stage review plus COORD recording. It contains no elapsed-time measurement for this unperformed act, so forty minutes is a planning estimate rather than a verified byte fact.

refutations.claim: A bare v2-to-v5 substitution using exactly the D-282 through D-287 pattern is a complete recipe.
refutations.evidence: D-282 through D-287 preserve OPEN target tokens, while file 08 and D-236 now give DR-104 a SATISFIED token. The mechanical occupancy refresh is analogous, but a valid successor also has to update its live file-08 token/pin and state that it neither replaces nor reopens D-236.
